evidence_links.relevance_note: The incident involves a confirmed embolic stroke, which is a serious incident requiring immediate reporting under EU MDR Article 87(1)-(2).
The code diff (ARTIFACT-DIFF-0009) may have contributed to the serious incident, necessitating immediate corrective action under EU MDR Article 10(12).

report.rationale: The incident report of a confirmed embolic stroke temporally linked to an unflagged rapid-ventricular-response atrial fibrillation episode is a serious patient safety risk that requires immediate action under EU MDR Article 87(1)-(2) and Article 10(12). The synthetic code diff (ARTIFACT-DIFF-0009) modifying the severity-scoring submodule, which was flagged as touching a safety-critical path by static analysis (ARTIFACT-STATICANALYSIS-0003), may have contributed to this serious incident. Although the regression was detected and blocked before clinical deployment, the potential for harm is significant given that the event led to a confirmed embolic stroke. The code diff introduces uncertainty in the safety-critical function's performance, which requires immediate review under EU MDR Article 10(12) due to the serious risk it poses.
